description: KTD17 repository regression policy. Quality (per mode, holdout macro-aggregates): average nDCG@10 and Recall@50 loss at most 2 percentage points, and no single run below baseline by more than 5 points. Latency (per matrix cell): candidate median-of-three run-level p95 at most 110% of the baseline median; each run-level p95 comes from raw request samples via the versioned nearest-rank rule, never pooled samples or averaged worker/query percentiles. Values are repository policy, not statistical confidence.
